ei.title: 2016년과 2022년 OECD 5개국의 성인 교육 및 훈련 참여 추세

fullPassage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was less than 20%.

questions.passage: The graph above shows (A)[trends / declines] in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the (B)[highest / lowest] in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was (C)[lower / higher] than that in 2022. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was less than 20%.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 추세(trends), 가장 높은(highest), 더 낮은(lower)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① trends — highest — lower: 그래프가 성인 참여 '추세'를 보여주고, 네덜란드가 '가장 높았으며', 이탈리아는 2016년이 2022년보다 '낮았음'.
❌ ② declines — highest — lower: (A) 그래프는 '감소'만이 아닌 '추세' 전체를 보여줌.
❌ ③ trends — lowest — lower: (B) 네덜란드가 '가장 낮은' 것이 아니라 '가장 높은' 비율.
❌ ④ trends — highest — higher: (C) 이탈리아 2016년이 2022년보다 '높은' 것이 아니라 '낮음'.
det.tip: trend(추세) ↔ decline(감소), highest(가장 높은) ↔ lowest(가장 낮은)

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult (A)[participation / withdrawal] in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was (B)[higher / lower] than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was (C)[less / more] than 20%.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 참여(participation), 더 높은(higher), 미만(less)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ participation — higher — less: 성인의 교육 '참여', 독일 2022년이 2016년보다 '높았고', 그리스는 20% '미만'.
❌ ① withdrawal — higher — less: (A) 교육에서의 '철수'가 아니라 '참여'.
❌ ② participation — lower — less: (B) 독일 2022년이 2016년보다 '낮은' 것이 아니라 '높음'.
❌ ④ participation — higher — more: (C) 그리스는 20% '이상'이 아니라 '미만'.
det.tip: participation(참여) ↔ withdrawal(철수), higher(더 높은) ↔ lower(더 낮은)

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the (A)[percentage / number] of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who (B)[participated / declined] in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. In each year (C)[listed / excluded], the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was less than 20%.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 비율(percentage), 참여한(participated), 나열된(listed)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② percentage — participated — listed: '비율'이 가장 높았고, 교육에 '참여한' 성인, 그래프에 '나열된' 연도.
❌ ① number — participated — listed: (A) 그래프가 보여주는 것은 '수'가 아니라 '비율(퍼센트)'.
❌ ③ percentage — declined — listed: (B) 교육에 '감소한'이 아니라 '참여한' 성인.
❌ ④ percentage — participated — excluded: (C) 그래프에서 '제외된' 연도가 아니라 '나열된' 연도.
det.tip: percentage(비율) ↔ number(수), participate(참여하다) ↔ decline(감소하다), listed(나열된) ↔ excluded(제외된)

questions.passage: The graph above shows ①<u>trends</u> in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who ②<u>participated</u> in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was ③<u>higher</u> than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was ④<u>more</u> than 20%.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ more(더 많은)→less(미만). 그리스는 매년 20% '미만'이었지 '이상'이 아님.
det.analysis:
❌ ① trends: 성인 참여 '추세'를 보여준다는 문맥에 적절.
❌ ② participated: 교육 훈련에 '참여한' 성인은 문맥에 적절.
❌ ③ higher: 독일 2022년이 2016년보다 '높았다'는 문맥에 적절.
✅ ④ more: less(미만)가 원문. more(이상)는 반의어로 문맥에 부적절.
det.tip: less than 20%(20% 미만) ↔ more than 20%(20% 이상)

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the ①<u>percentage</u> of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was ②<u>lower</u> than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was ③<u>lower</u> in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② lower(더 낮은)→higher(더 높은). 독일은 2022년이 2016년보다 '높았다'는 것이 원문.
det.analysis:
❌ ① percentage: 성인의 '비율'은 문맥에 적절.
✅ ② lower: higher(더 높은)가 원문. lower(더 낮은)는 반의어로 문맥에 부적절.
❌ ③ lower: 2022년에 스페인이 독일보다 '낮았다'는 문맥에 적절.
❌ ④ less: 그리스가 20% '미만'이라는 문맥에 적절.
det.tip: higher(더 높은) ↔ lower(더 낮은). 비교급 반의어 쌍에 주의.

questions.passage: The graph above shows ①<u>trends</u> in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year ②<u>omitted</u> in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was ③<u>lower</u> in Spain than in Germany. In Italy, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2016 was lower than that in 2022. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who ④<u>participated</u> in education and training was less than 20%.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② omitted(생략된)→listed(나열된). 그래프에 '나열된' 연도이지 '생략된' 연도가 아님.
det.analysis:
❌ ① trends: 성인 참여 '추세'를 보여준다는 문맥에 적절.
✅ ② omitted: listed(나열된)가 원문. omitted(생략된)는 반의적 의미로 문맥에 부적절.
❌ ③ lower: 2022년에 스페인이 독일보다 '낮았다'는 문맥에 적절.
❌ ④ participated: 교육 훈련에 '참여한' 성인은 문맥에 적절.
det.tip: listed(나열된, 기재된) ↔ omitted(생략된, 빠뜨린). list(목록에 올리다) ↔ omit(빠뜨리다)

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 교육과 '훈련'에의 참여라는 문맥에서 training(훈련)이 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ training: 훈련. 'education and training(교육과 훈련)'은 OECD 통계의 표준 용어.
❌ ① funding: 자금 지원. 교육과 '자금 지원'의 참여는 부자연스러움.
❌ ② tourism: 관광. 교육과 완전히 다른 분야.
❌ ③ retirement: 은퇴. 성인 '교육과 은퇴'에의 참여는 문맥에 맞지 않음.
det.tip: education and training = 교육 및 훈련. OECD에서 자주 쓰이는 표현.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성인의 교육 훈련 '참여'라는 문맥에서 participation(참여)이 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① participation: 참여. 'adult participation in education(성인의 교육 참여)'이라는 표현으로 적절.
❌ ② competition: 경쟁. 교육 훈련에서의 '경쟁'은 그래프의 주제와 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ observation: 관찰. 교육 훈련의 '관찰'은 참여와 다른 개념.
❌ ④ registration: 등록. 참여(participation)와 유사하지만 그래프가 보여주는 것은 실제 '참여' 비율.
det.tip: participation(참여) = involvement, engagement. participate in = take part in

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성인의 '비율'이 가장 높았다는 문맥에서 percentage(비율)가 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ percentage: 비율. 그래프에서 각 나라의 성인 '비율'을 비교하는 문맥에 적절.
❌ ① majority: 다수. '다수가 가장 높았다'는 표현은 부자연스러움.
❌ ② population: 인구. 인구 자체가 높은 것이 아니라 참여 비율이 높은 것.
❌ ③ quantity: 양. 구체적인 퍼센트를 나타내는 '비율'이 아닌 '양'은 부적절.
det.tip: percentage(비율, 퍼센트) = proportion, ratio. the percentage of ~ = ~의 비율

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>trends</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: trends = 추세, 경향. tendencies(경향)가 가장 가까운 의미입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② tendencies: 경향, 추세. trend와 동의어.
❌ ① causes: 원인. trend와 다른 의미.
❌ ③ solutions: 해결책. 추세와 관련 없음.
❌ ④ limits: 한계. 추세를 나타내는 말이 아님.
det.tip: trend = tendency, pattern, direction. 데이터의 변화 경향을 나타냄.

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who <u>participated</u> in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>participated</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: participated = 참여하다. took part(참여하다)가 가장 가까운 의미입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ took part: 참여하다. participate in = take part in.
❌ ① invested: 투자하다. 교육에 '투자'한 것과 '참여'한 것은 다른 의미.
❌ ② competed: 경쟁하다. 교육에 '경쟁'한 것은 문맥에 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ resulted: 결과를 낳다. participate와 다른 의미.
det.tip: participate in = take part in = engage in = join in. 모두 '참여하다'의 뜻.

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the <u>percentage</u> of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>percentage</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: percentage = 비율, 퍼센트. proportion(비율)이 가장 가까운 의미입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ proportion: 비율, 부분. percentage와 동의어.
❌ ① frequency: 빈도. 비율과는 다른 통계 개념.
❌ ② amount: 양. 비율(상대적 수치)과 양(절대적 수치)은 다름.
❌ ③ average: 평균. 비율과 평균은 다른 개념.
det.tip: percentage = proportion = ratio = rate. 모두 '비율'을 뜻하지만 쓰임이 약간 다름.

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the <u>highest</u> in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. In each year listed, the percentage of adults in Greece who participated in education and training was less than 20%.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>highest</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: highest = 가장 높은. lowest(가장 낮은)가 반의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② lowest: 가장 낮은. highest(가장 높은)의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① largest: 가장 큰. high의 반의어는 low이지 large가 아님.
❌ ③ nearest: 가장 가까운. highest와 반의 관계 아님.
❌ ④ fastest: 가장 빠른. highest와 다른 차원.
det.tip: highest(가장 높은) ↔ lowest(가장 낮은). high — higher — highest ↔ low — lower — lowest

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult <u>participation</u> in education and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. Among these countries, the percentage of adults in the Netherlands who participated in education and training was the highest in each year listed in the graph. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016. In 2022, the percentage of adults who participated in education and training was lower in Spain than in Germany. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>participation</u>과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: participation = 참여. exclusion(배제)이 반의어입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ exclusion: 배제, 제외. participation(참여)의 반의어.
❌ ① contribution: 기여. 참여와 유사한 의미이지 반대가 아님.
❌ ② cooperation: 협력. 참여와 관련은 있으나 반의어 아님.
❌ ④ celebration: 축하. participation과 반의 관계 아님.
det.tip: participation(참여) ↔ exclusion(배제). include(포함하다) ↔ exclude(배제하다)

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 training이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은? (A) Adults participated in education and training programs. (B) The dog completed its training and can now follow commands.

det.korean: (A) 직업 훈련/연수, (B) (동물) 훈련/조련. 같은 단어이지만 맥락에 따라 의미가 다릅니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 직업 훈련 — 조련: (A) 성인 교육과 함께 쓰여 '직업 훈련'의 의미, (B) 개가 명령을 따르게 된 '조련'의 의미.
❌ ② 체력 단련 — 조련: (A) 교육과 함께 쓰인 training은 '체력 단련'보다 '직업 훈련'이 적절.
❌ ③ 직업 훈련 — 연습: (B) 개의 '연습'보다 '조련'이 적절.
❌ ④ 체력 단련 — 연습: (A)와 (B) 모두 부적절한 의미.
det.tip: training: ① 직업 훈련/연수(education and training) ② 체력 단련(physical training) ③ 조련(animal training)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the act of taking part in an activity or event"

det.korean: 활동이나 행사에 참여하는 행위 → participation(참여)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ participation: 참여. 정의에 정확히 부합.
❌ ① observation: 관찰. '참여'가 아닌 '지켜보는 것'.
❌ ② evaluation: 평가. 활동에 참여하는 것이 아닌 판단하는 것.
❌ ④ preparation: 준비. 활동 자체에 참여하는 것이 아닌 사전 준비.
det.tip: participation = the act of taking part. participate(동사) → participation(명사)

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: participate(동사) → participation(명사). adult 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 명사형이 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ participation: 동사 participate의 명사형. 'adult participation(성인 참여)'이라는 명사구 구조에 적절.
❌ participating: 현재분사/동명사. 가능하지만 원문은 participation.
❌ participated: 과거분사. 명사 자리에 부적절.
❌ participatory: 형용사형. 명사 자리에 부적절.
det.tip: participate(동사) → participation(명사) → participatory(형용사). -tion 어미는 명사.

questions.passage: The graph above shows trends in adult participation in __________ (educate) and training in five OECD countries in 2016 and 2022. In Germany, the percentage of adults who participated in __________ and training in 2022 was higher than that in 2016.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: educate(동사) → education(명사). 전치사 in 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 명사형이 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ education: 동사 educate의 명사형. 'participation in education(교육 참여)'이라는 전치사구 구조에 적절.
❌ educational: 형용사형. 전치사 뒤 명사 자리에 형용사는 부적절.
❌ educated: 과거분사/형용사. 명사 자리에 부적절.
❌ educating: 현재분사. 가능하지만 원문은 education.
det.tip: educate(동사) → education(명사) → educational(형용사) → educated(과거분사/형용사). -tion 어미는 명사.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그래프에 '나열된' 각 연도라는 문맥에서 listed(나열된)가 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① listed: 나열된, 기재된. 그래프에 나열된 연도라는 표현으로 적절.
❌ ② removed: 제거된. 그래프에서 '제거된' 연도는 문맥에 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ predicted: 예측된. 2016년과 2022년은 실제 데이터이지 예측이 아님.
❌ ④ estimated: 추정된. 그래프에 '추정된' 것이 아닌 '나열된' 연도.
det.tip: listed = 나열된, 기재된. list(동사: 나열하다) → listed(과거분사: 나열된)

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 2022년 비율이 2016년의 '그것(비율)'보다 높았다는 문맥에서 that(그것)이 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ that: 앞에 나온 'the percentage'를 대신하는 대명사. 반복을 피하기 위해 that을 사용.
❌ ① this: 가까운 것을 가리키는 대명사. 비교 대상(2016년)을 가리키기에 that이 적절.
❌ ② those: 복수 대명사. percentage는 단수이므로 that이 적절.
❌ ③ these: 복수 지시대명사. 단수 percentage를 대신하기에 부적절.
det.tip: that = 앞에 나온 단수 명사를 대신하는 대명사. 비교 구문에서 'higher than that(= the percentage) in 2016' 형태로 자주 사용.
